---
title: "Analysis"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(southparkr)

episode_lines |>
  # Remove colons/quotes attached to some character names (e.g., "Cartman:")
  mutate(character = str_remove_all(character, "[:\"]")) |>
  filter(character %in% c("Stan", "Kyle", "Cartman", "Kenny")) |>
  count(season_number, character) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = season_number, y = n, color = character)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:21) +
  labs(
    title = "Dialogue by Main South Park Characters Across Seasons",
    subtitle = "Cartman consistently has the most lines, while Kenny has the fewest",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Number of Dialogue Lines",
    color = "Character",
    caption = "Source: southparkr package"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
episode_lines |>
  mutate(character = str_remove_all(character, "[:\"]")) |>
  filter(character %in% c("Randy", "Mr. Garrison", "Chef", "Gerald", "Sharon", "Mr. Mackey")) |>
  count(season_number, character) |>
  # Fill in 0 for seasons where a character had no lines (e.g., Chef in later seasons)
  complete(season_number = 1:21, character, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = season_number, y = n, color = character)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:21) +
  labs(
    title = "Dialogue by Significant Adult Characters Across Seasons",
    subtitle = "Randy Marsh rises dramatically after Season 8 to dominate adult dialogue",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Number of Dialogue Lines",
    color = "Character",
    caption = "Source: southparkr package"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
